## Pages

- Home ({{ site.domain }}/): Profile, selected projects, skills, education, and contact links.
- Projects ({{ site.domain }}/projects/): Index of every project with a case-study link.
- Project pages ({{ site.domain }}/projects/<slug>/): Full write-up, stack, repository, and live preview where available.
- Feed ({{ site.domain }}/feed/): Short public build notes and progress updates.
- CV ({{ site.domain }}/cv/): Current CV, viewable in the browser and downloadable as a PDF.
- RSS ({{ site.domain }}/feed/rss/): Feed posts as RSS 2.0.
